definitions: A closing curly bracket, used in pairs with an opening curly bracket ({) to enclose text or data, especially in programming languages, mathematics, and dictionaries.
In mathematics, it is used to denote a set or to group terms.
In programming, it is often used to define code blocks or to enclose objects and arrays.
examples: The function is defined as f(x) = { x^2 if x >= 0, -x if x < 0 }.
In JavaScript, an object might look like { "name": "John", "age": 30 }.
